scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.resolve(__dirname,'../packages/shared-types');const dest=path.resolve(__dirname,'shared-types');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});console.log('Copied shared-types');}else{console.log('shared-types not found, using npm package');}"
